description: Per-control templates the OIS generator (Phase 6 of the Control Adjudication Ecosystem roadmap) renders against observed register-entry counts to produce live SSP implementation statements. Template placeholders use {{count.<register_key>.<entry_type>.<lifecycle_state>}} and {{total.<register_key>.<entry_type>}} resolved by the generator. Controls without a template fall back to a generic auto-generated paragraph.
generic_fallback: Control {{control_id}} ({{family}} family) is implemented through the registers {{register_keys_csv}}. In the period {{period_start}}…{{period_end}} the codex observed {{total_entries}} register entries across these surfaces ({{lifecycle_breakdown}}). The most recent admin- or ISSO-signed entry is {{most_recent_evidence_at_human}}. Cadence requirement: {{cadence_days_required}}d. {{cadence_status_sentence}}

templates.3.1.1: Authorized access to the MacTech CUI enclave is enforced through Azure RBAC role assignments captured in the access_authorization register and continuously observed by EnclaveWatch. In the last {{period_days}} days the codex recorded {{total.access_authorization.grant_access}} role grants and {{total.access_authorization.modify_access}} modifications. Privileged role grants (Owner / Contributor / User Access Administrator) are gated through the Pattern A closed loop introduced in Phase 1 — {{count.access_authorization.privileged_grant_acknowledgment.isso_verified}} of {{total.access_authorization.privileged_grant_acknowledgment}} privileged grants in the period have been ISSO-verified, with {{count.access_authorization.privileged_grant_acknowledgment.draft}} pending admin justification within the 72-hour SLA. Termination workflow disables accounts within one business day, evidenced by {{total.termination.account_disablement}} disablement events. Authorized identities are inventoried weekly via the identity_inventory register ({{total.identity_inventory.inventory_snapshot}} snapshots in the period).
templates.3.1.5: The principle of least privilege is enforced through Azure RBAC with continuous observation of role assignments, the privileged-grant acknowledgment closed loop (Phase 1 of Register-Automation v1.1), and weekly ISSO review of the access_authorization register. In the period the codex observed {{total.access_authorization.grant_access}} role assignments — {{count.access_authorization.privileged_grant_acknowledgment.isso_verified}} privileged grants ISSO-verified out of {{total.access_authorization.privileged_grant_acknowledgment}} detected, {{count.access_authorization.weekly_review_finding.auto_recorded}} weekly-review findings filed by the ISSO. The role_assignment_matrix register captures the canonical role-to-user mapping ({{total.role_assignment_matrix.role_to_user_mapping_update}} updates in the period). Off-boarding triggers RBAC removal within one business day evidenced by the termination register ({{total.termination.offboarding_completed}} offboardings).
templates.3.1.6: Privileged accounts are explicitly tracked and reviewed weekly. The access_authorization register holds {{total.access_authorization.privileged_grant_acknowledgment}} privileged-grant acknowledgments in the period ({{count.access_authorization.privileged_grant_acknowledgment.isso_verified}} ISSO-verified). The role_assignment_matrix records {{total.role_assignment_matrix.role_definition_update}} role-definition updates. The ISSO weekly-review process surfaces dormant or unjustified privileged accounts as weekly_review_finding entries ({{total.access_authorization.weekly_review_finding}} in the period); each finding's recommended_action is tracked through to admin remediation.
templates.3.1.7: Non-privileged users are denied execution of privileged functions. The break-glass account is the sole exception and every break-glass sign-in is captured by EnclaveWatch through the maintenance_log register's break_glass_acknowledgment flow (Pattern A — Sprint 2). In the period the codex observed {{total.maintenance_log.break_glass_acknowledgment}} break-glass sign-ins, {{count.maintenance_log.break_glass_acknowledgment.isso_verified}} ISSO-verified within SLA, {{count.maintenance_log.break_glass_acknowledgment.escalated}} escalated. The Windows Security log audit_log_review captures privileged-function execution attempts on the host fleet ({{total.audit_log_review.weekly_review}} weekly reviews completed).
templates.3.3.1: Audit logs are collected continuously and reviewed weekly. EnclaveWatch ingests the Security, PowerShell/Operational, WMI-Activity, TaskScheduler/Operational, System, Application, WinRM/Operational, Defender/Operational, RDP, NTLM, Kernel-PnP, CodeIntegrity, BITS, AppLocker, and Sysmon channels into the events table for centralized review. The audit_log_review register captures the ISSO's weekly review attestation ({{total.audit_log_review.weekly_review}} in the period; result_summary attached). Alert investigations land as alert_investigation entries ({{total.audit_log_review.alert_investigation}} in the period).
templates.3.3.2: Audit log content meets DoD content requirements (timestamp, event type, actor, success/failure, source/destination, object). Every entry written by EnclaveWatch's NormalizedEvent collector or by ISSO export handlers carries the §1 auditor-defensible field set: actor_*, event_type + event_classification, four time anchors, system + scope + vault + boundary, business_justification, detection_method, outcome + actions_taken, verified_by, lifecycle_state, evidence_refs, provenance. {{total_register_entries_with_lifecycle_state}} entries observed in the period meet this standard; {{count_legacy_backfilled}} legacy entries were backfilled by migration 0057.
templates.3.3.3: Audit log review is performed by the ISSO weekly. The audit_log_review register's weekly_review entry type captures every signed weekly review ({{total.audit_log_review.weekly_review}} in the period). The review covers Security, PowerShell, Sysmon, and Windows Defender channels at minimum; results land as register entries with lifecycle_state = isso_verified. Findings flow into the assessment_findings register's review_observation entry type ({{total.assessment_findings.review_observation}} in the period).
templates.3.3.5: Audit failures and anomalies are correlated and reviewed. EnclaveWatch's correlation worker (CorrelationAlertWorker) joins NormalizedEvents into correlation alerts on a per-minute cadence; the codex's threat-narrative engine (Phase 9) further joins across registers to surface multi-event threat stories. In the period the codex recorded {{total_correlation_alerts}} correlation alerts and {{total_threat_narratives}} threat narratives. The audit_log_review register's alert_investigation entry type captures investigation outcomes ({{total.audit_log_review.alert_investigation}}).
templates.3.4.1: The configured baseline for each information system is captured in the baseline_config register and continuously observed for drift through EnclaveWatch's Sysmon-based ConfigurationDriftCollector (Phase 2 of Register-Automation v1.1). In the period the baseline_config register holds {{total.baseline_config.baseline_created}} baseline records with {{total.baseline_config.baseline_update}} approved updates. Sysmon-detected baseline-protected file/registry/service changes that did NOT match a change_log entry within ±60 minutes land as change_drift_acknowledgment drafts on the change_drift_log register — {{total.change_drift_log.change_drift_acknowledgment}} drift events in the period, {{count.change_drift_log.change_drift_acknowledgment.isso_verified}} ISSO-verified, {{count.change_drift_log.change_drift_acknowledgment.draft}} pending admin justification.
templates.3.4.2: Security configuration settings are enforced through the baseline_config register and validated through EnclaveWatch's canonical-checks cadence (30 OS hardening checks in production). The change_log register captures every authorized configuration change ({{total.change_log.change_implemented}} in the period) and the change_drift_log register captures every Sysmon-detected change that did NOT match a logged change ({{total.change_drift_log.change_drift_acknowledgment}} in the period). The ISSO reviews drift events weekly through the Phase 2 Pattern A loop.
templates.3.4.3: Configuration changes are tracked, reviewed, and approved before implementation. The change_log register holds {{total.change_log.change_request}} change requests, {{total.change_log.change_approved}} approvals, {{total.change_log.change_implemented}} implementations, and {{total.change_log.change_backout}} backouts in the period. Configuration drift outside the change_log is flagged for admin justification through the Phase 2 Pattern A loop ({{total.change_drift_log.change_drift_acknowledgment}} drift events).
templates.3.6.1: Incident response is operational. EnclaveWatch's correlation worker fires per-event correlation alerts; the codex's incident_log register captures every incident ({{total.incident_log.incident_opened}} opened in the period; {{total.incident_log.incident_update}} updates). The Phase 3 defender_alert_acknowledgment closed loop adds Microsoft Defender for Endpoint high-severity alerts to the same register — {{total.incident_log.defender_alert_acknowledgment}} alerts in the period, {{count.incident_log.defender_alert_acknowledgment.isso_verified}} ISSO-verified, {{count.incident_log.defender_alert_acknowledgment.draft}} pending admin acknowledgment within the 24-hour SLA. Incident-response tabletops land in the incident_log as tabletop_or_test entries ({{total.incident_log.tabletop_or_test}} in the period).
templates.3.6.2: Incidents are tracked, documented, and reported. The incident_log register's incident_opened, incident_update, defender_alert_acknowledgment, and tabletop_or_test entry types form the consolidated record of every incident, alert, and exercise. In the period the codex observed {{total.incident_log.incident_opened}} incidents opened, {{total.incident_log.incident_update}} updates, {{total.incident_log.defender_alert_acknowledgment}} Defender alerts, and {{total.incident_log.tabletop_or_test}} IR exercises. Reporting to leadership and authorities is captured in the incident details and supporting evidence_refs[].
templates.3.7.1: System maintenance is performed and authorized. The maintenance_log register's scheduled_maintenance, emergency_maintenance, and remote_maintenance_session entry types capture every maintenance activity ({{total.maintenance_log.scheduled_maintenance}}, {{total.maintenance_log.emergency_maintenance}}, {{total.maintenance_log.remote_maintenance_session}} respectively). Break-glass sessions are a separate Pattern A loop on the same register: {{total.maintenance_log.break_glass_acknowledgment}} in the period ({{count.maintenance_log.break_glass_acknowledgment.isso_verified}} ISSO-verified).
templates.3.7.2: Maintenance tools, techniques, mechanisms, and personnel are controlled. Remote maintenance sessions are gated and logged through the maintenance_log register's remote_maintenance_session entry type, with session_recording_required and supervised_by fields populated per session. {{total.maintenance_log.remote_maintenance_session}} remote sessions in the period.
templates.3.7.5: Multi-factor authentication is required to establish remote and privileged sessions. Remote-access authorization is tracked through the remote_access_authorization register's authorize_remote_access entry type ({{total.remote_access_authorization.authorize_remote_access}} authorizations, {{total.remote_access_authorization.annual_remote_access_review}} annual reviews). MFA enrollment is tracked through authenticator_mgmt's mfa_enrollment entry type ({{total.authenticator_mgmt.mfa_enrollment}} enrollments). Break-glass sign-ins on the maintenance_log are MFA-gated by Azure Conditional Access and observed by EnclaveWatch via the Pattern A break_glass_acknowledgment loop ({{total.maintenance_log.break_glass_acknowledgment}} sign-ins).
templates.3.10.6: Alternate work site access is controlled. Privileged grants from non-corp networks are flagged through the access_authorization register's privileged_grant_acknowledgment closed loop (Phase 1) — {{count.access_authorization.privileged_grant_acknowledgment.isso_verified}} of {{total.access_authorization.privileged_grant_acknowledgment}} privileged grants ISSO-verified in the period.
templates.3.11.2: Vulnerability scanning is performed continuously. EnclaveWatch's vulnerability collectors (MDVM scan + AUM cadence path) feed the vuln_remediation register: {{total.vuln_remediation.vulnerability_detected}} detections, {{total.vuln_remediation.patched_or_remediated}} patches, {{total.vuln_remediation.risk_accepted}} risk acceptances, {{total.vuln_remediation.verification_observed}} ISSO verifications in the period.
templates.3.11.3: Vulnerabilities are remediated within the SLA. The vuln_remediation register tracks every CVE: detected_at sets the SLA clock; patched_at closes it. In the period {{count.vuln_remediation.patched_or_remediated.auto_recorded}} were patched within SLA; {{count.vuln_remediation.risk_accepted.auto_recorded}} were risk-accepted with documented compensating_controls.
templates.3.12.1: Periodic security control assessments are performed. The assessment_findings register's assessment_performed entry type captures formal assessment events ({{total.assessment_findings.assessment_performed}} in the period). The ISSO weekly review observation type (review_observation) provides lighter-weight ongoing assessment ({{total.assessment_findings.review_observation}} observations in the period).
templates.3.12.3: Security controls are continuously monitored. The codex's continuous-monitoring page (/dashboard/monitoring) surfaces every signal in real time. In the period the system observed {{weekly_manifests_received}} signed ISSO weekly exports refreshing the continuous-monitoring posture for ~{{controls_refreshed_per_manifest}} controls per export. Pattern A closed loops on four high-value detection surfaces (break-glass, privileged grants, configuration drift, Defender alerts) provide event-level continuous monitoring beyond the weekly cadence.
templates.3.12.4: The system security plan is maintained current. The policy_review register tracks document review cadence: {{total.policy_review.policy_review_completed}} policy reviews, {{total.policy_review.procedure_review_completed}} procedure reviews, {{total.policy_review.governance_exception_recorded}} exceptions, {{total.policy_review.stale_document_flag}} stale-document flags by the ISSO in the period. The Phase 6 Observed-Implementation Statement engine (this document) auto-generates per-control narratives from observed register entries on every weekly export — replacing static SSP prose with a content-hash-traceable derivation.
templates.3.14.1: Information system flaws are identified, reported, and corrected. The vuln_remediation register's vulnerability_detected → patched_or_remediated lifecycle drives this control ({{total.vuln_remediation.vulnerability_detected}} detected, {{total.vuln_remediation.patched_or_remediated}} corrected in the period). Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management (MDVM) integrated via the AUM cadence path provides the primary detection signal.
templates.3.14.2: Malicious code protection is implemented. The Phase 3 defender_alert_acknowledgment closed loop on the incident_log register captures every high-severity Microsoft Defender for Endpoint alert: {{total.incident_log.defender_alert_acknowledgment}} in the period ({{count.incident_log.defender_alert_acknowledgment.isso_verified}} ISSO-verified, {{count.incident_log.defender_alert_acknowledgment.draft}} pending admin acknowledgment within the 24-hour SLA). The vuln_remediation register tracks the broader malware/EDR-integrity signal.
templates.3.14.6: System security alerts and advisories are reviewed and acted upon. The Phase 3 defender_alert_acknowledgment closed loop captures every Microsoft Defender for Endpoint high-severity alert ({{total.incident_log.defender_alert_acknowledgment}} in the period); MITRE technique tagging on each alert links observation to threat intelligence. Admin investigation outcomes (true_positive_remediated / true_positive_in_progress / false_positive_investigated / risk_accepted) are recorded per alert with ISSO sign-off on next weekly review.
